roadmap.title: First playthrough
roadmap.description: Play the story once on Storyteller or another easy setting. Fill the free calendar days with virtues, followers, books, cooking, quests, debates and gold beetles, then clear the final dungeon for the secret boss.

roadmap.title: New Game+
roadmap.description: Start New Game+ on Easy or harder, rebuild levels, and defeat the redscale dragon from the Book of Apocalypse. The last achievement then unlocks.

steps.text: Earn the other 43 achievements. Closing the Book is the last, in @mechanic{New Game+}.

achievements.summary: Watch the ending of the story.

steps.text: Play the story through the final dungeon and watch the ending.

achievements.summary: Clear the Northern Border Fort dungeon.

steps.text: Play through the @loc{Northern Border Fort} mission.
Play through the @loc{Nord Mines} mission.

achievements.summary: Clear the Regalith Grand Cathedral dungeon.

steps.text: Play through the @loc{Regalith Grand Cathedral} mission.
Play through the @loc{Kriegante Castle} mission.
Play through the @loc{Charadrius} infiltration mission.

guide.context: This dungeon is long. Plan 3 to 4 hours to clear it fully.

steps.text: Play through the @loc{Dragon Temple} mission.
Play through the @loc{Montario Opera House} mission.
Play through the @loc{Skybound Avatar} mission.

achievements.description: Defeat the redscale dragon from the Book of Apocalypse.
achievements.summary: Beat the redscale dragon that lives in the Book of Apocalypse, in New Game+.

guide.context: The book is chained up in the first playthrough and cannot be opened on Storyteller. Save your rainbow bathsalts for this fight.

steps.text: Finish the story once, then start @mechanic{New Game+} on Easy or harder.
Rebuild your levels. Aim for about level 70.
In @loc{Akademeia}, open the Book of Apocalypse on the pedestal and fight the redscale dragon.
Use the @mechanic{Prince} archetype's Hero's Cry and Sublime Spoonful meals, then exploit weaknesses for extra turns.

achievements.description: Defeat the secret form of the final boss.
achievements.sortReason: Final dungeon, before the last boss.
achievements.summary: Defeat Destroyer Charadrius, the secret form of the final boss.

guide.context: Fighting any human boss in the small side areas of The Tyrant's Star removes the secret form. Human minibosses that wander the main areas are safe to fight.

steps.text: In @loc{The Tyrant's Star}, skip the human bosses in the small side areas reached by the moving platforms.
Go straight to the final boss. Save right before the fight.
Defeat Destroyer Charadrius.
Reload your save if you want to fight the skipped bosses for their drops.
Level any archetype to its maximum by fighting battles with it equipped.

achievements.description: Master all the Archetypes with the protagonist.
achievements.summary: Master every Archetype with the protagonist.

guide.context: After an archetype is mastered, every extra 1,000 A-EXP turns into an item. Spend those items to unlock and level other archetypes on the protagonist. Destroy the red crystals for consumables worth 3,000 XP.

steps.text: Unlock every archetype on the protagonist.
Level each one to mastery, switching as each is mastered or grinding at the end.
For a fast farm, farm the red magla crystals and the two spawners (tooth and miniboss) in @loc{The Tyrant's Star}.

guide.context: The Prince archetype is lost in New Game+ until you earn it again.

steps.text: Master the Royal archetypes of your party, then talk to @npc{More} in @loc{Akademeia}.
Study the @mechanic{Prince} archetype when it is offered in the late story.

achievements.description: Use a Synthesis skill for the first time.

steps.text: In battle, press Q to combine archetype attacks.
Press Q in battle to try different synthesis combinations. Test new ones as you unlock archetypes.

guide.context: The option also appears while you work on Summon Mask Time.

steps.text: After the needed ally joins, talk to @npc{More} in @loc{Akademeia} and choose "Special Experiments".
Perform one experiment.

achievements.description: Create all summoning vessels and masks.
achievements.summary: Create every summoning vessel and mask.

guide.context: The Eugief merchant sells mask parts after you buy info from the Virga Island informant. You can buy only 1 of each part per day, and stock changes by weekday. Check what parts you still need before the final dungeon.

steps.text: Collect mask materials from enemy drops. They start during the @loc{Charadrius} mission.
Collect summon talismans, or buy them in the island market. Buy missing mask parts from the Eugief merchant on Seabreeze Street in Brilehaven.
Craft vessels and masks with @npc{More} until all are made.

guide.context: Do this in the overworld, in an open area.

steps.text: On the overworld, hit an enemy without taking a hit until the yellow bar by its health bar is empty.

achievements.description: Inflict ambush damage against stunned enemies 100 times.
achievements.summary: Deal ambush damage to stunned enemies 100 times.

steps.text: Stun an enemy on the overworld, then start the battle. You or an ally deals ambush damage to start. Repeat 100 times.

achievements.description: Steal an item from an enemy.
achievements.summary: Steal an item from an enemy.

steps.text: After @npc{Heismay} joins, use his steal skill on an enemy. You can inherit the skill onto others.

achievements.description: Spend a total of 100,000 reeve using skills that consume money.
achievements.summary: Spend 100,000 reeve in total on skills that cost money.

steps.text: Unlock the @mechanic{Merchant} archetype through @npc{Brigitta}.
Use Merchant skills that cost reeve until you have spent 100,000. You can inherit them onto another archetype.

guide.context: An Elementa runs away after one turn unless you stun it first. Each orb is weak to one element: a blue orb to Fire, red to Ice, green to Electric and gold to Wind. Light and Dark orbs are weak to each other's element.

steps.text: Chase an Elementa on the overworld. It flees, so stun it or fight it quickly.
Defeat 10 of them.

guide.context: The first Northern Border Fort mission gives a good start. A second playthrough adds many more.

steps.text: Defeat enemies before they act. Stun them first when you can. Keep going until you reach 50.

achievements.description: Make all possible gold beetle item exchanges.
achievements.summary: Complete every gold beetle item exchange.

guide.context: You need 46 of the 50 beetles. Only 3 can be missed for good.

steps.text: Pick up each small gold beetle in dungeons and cities. Check the minimap for items.
Trade beetles to the gold beetle vendors, starting with the old man on the Arenafront Wharf, Brilehaven.
Make the last exchange, which gives a weapon and the achievement.
Do not miss the camp beetle after the @loc{Northern Border Fort}. Turn the camera behind you when you get control.
Finish the @loc{Dental Distress} quest before its deadline for its beetle.
Check the @loc{Ancient Eldan Sanctum} for a beetle next to a collapsed house.

guide.context: Do it in @loc{Akademeia} or at the inn when you have spare time. She has only one line each time.

steps.text: Press T to talk to @npc{Gallica} and skip her line. Repeat 100 times.
Play the early story. Talk to @npc{Basilio} on the Gauntlet Runner to add him as a follower.

achievements.summary: Raise every Follower to the maximum rank.

guide.context: Followers rank up by talking to them when a rank-up shows. Each one needs certain virtue ranks. Some talks are at night.

collectibles.name: Gallica
collectibles.method: Her rank rises on its own at set story points.

collectibles.name: Strohl
collectibles.method: Talk when a rank-up shows. He later gives a sidequest. He needs Imagination.

collectibles.name: Hulkenberg
collectibles.method: Talk when a rank-up shows. She needs Wisdom.

collectibles.name: Heismay
collectibles.method: Talk when a rank-up shows. He needs Eloquence and Imagination.

collectibles.name: Junah
collectibles.method: Talk when you can. Most rank-ups are at night. She needs Imagination.

collectibles.name: Eupha
collectibles.method: Finish her sidequest at @loc{Mt. Vulkano} first. She needs Eloquence and Wisdom.

collectibles.name: Basilio
collectibles.method: Talk to him on the Gauntlet Runner to add him. He needs Imagination and Eloquence.
collectibles.note: At rank 7 or 8 the follower menu may not show a rank-up. Talk to him anyway.

collectibles.name: Neuras
collectibles.method: Bring back his relics from dungeons. His book hangs at the engine room entrance.

collectibles.name: Maria
collectibles.method: Give her the Midnight Sunsands drawing. She needs Tolerance.

collectibles.name: Catherina
collectibles.method: Finish her sidequest in the Mausoleum. Fight her runner when it shows on the world map, to raise the early ranks. She needs Tolerance.

collectibles.name: Alonzo
collectibles.method: Start his sidequest in Martira. He needs Imagination, Wisdom, Tolerance and Courage.

collectibles.name: Bardon
collectibles.method: Take his sidequest. He needs Eloquence.

collectibles.name: Brigitta
collectibles.method: Raise Wisdom at the nearby bench to start her sidequest. She needs Wisdom and Courage.

collectibles.name: More
collectibles.method: Do his archetype sidequests and study more archetypes to rank him up.

guide.context: Informants in local taverns tell you what ingredients each region sells. The pantry gives free ingredients every day, including Gauntlet Shrooms. Sublime Spoonful needs Gauntlet Shrooms, a Lord of the Lake fish and Queen's Honey.

steps.text: Learn new recipes as allies join. Buy ingredients in each new city and town.
Cook each recipe once in the Gauntlet Runner kitchen.
After all are made, cook the last recipe that unlocks.
Accept a bounty at a Recruitment Center.
Defeat the target in its dungeon and report back.

guide.context: There are 76 quests. New quests also appear in the last 30 days. Finish Dental Distress before its deadline.

steps.text: Check the requests page in every new city and take every quest.
Finish main quests, side quests, bounties, follower quests and the coliseum questline.
Open the Completed tab and count. At 75 of 76, the last quest is the one left to do.
Reach Wisdom 2. Visit St. Feremis Church in Grand Trad and purify a piece of equipment.

achievements.summary: Buy an item on a discount.

steps.text: Wait for Idlesday, which falls every 5th day. Buy any item on sale.

guide.context: These are small towns, not story cities. Each one opens through a bounty or a quest.

collectibles.name: Ligno
collectibles.method: Take the bounty The Greater One-Eyed Scoundrel.

collectibles.name: Komero
collectibles.method: Accept the bounty called The Man-Eater in the Mine.

collectibles.name: Inundo
collectibles.method: Take the bounty Grieving Ghost of the Goblet.

collectibles.name: Silento
collectibles.method: Take the quest Peak Curiosity.

collectibles.name: Malva
collectibles.method: Take the quest Warmth in Winter.

guide.context: The map only completes after the last dungeon unlocks.

steps.text: Complete every quest. Quests unlock most of the map.
Fight every gauntlet runner that appears on the map.
Once "Prepare for the final battle" begins (12 September), speak to @npc{Loveless} and @npc{Rudolph} outside the Altabury Inn. Each adds a runner to the map.
After @loc{Martira}, walk both paths toward the @loc{Forsaken Tower} to meet all 3 runners there.
Unlock the last dungeon, @loc{The Tyrant's Star}.

achievements.description: Collect all drawings of the journey.
achievements.summary: Collect all 13 drawings of the journey.

guide.context: One drawing, Midnight Sunsands, is needed for Maria's bond. Hand your drawings to Maria to put them in the Honeybee Art Gallery.

steps.text: While traveling between destinations, find the greyed-out squares and collect each drawing.
Visit every area of the game.

achievements.summary: Win the debate against all eight candidates.

guide.context: Each candidate leaves after a set time, so you cannot go back if you miss one. Check the podium when you reach a city and every day after. Save often. Virga Island has no podium.

collectibles.name: Lina
collectibles.method: Choose "What are your policies?"

collectibles.name: Roger
collectibles.method: Choose "Taxes benefit us all."

collectibles.name: Loveless
collectibles.method: Choose "Alcohol won't bring equality."

collectibles.name: Jin
collectibles.method: Choose "We should help anyone."

collectibles.name: Glodell
collectibles.method: Choose "You only parrot Louis?"

collectibles.name: Rudolph
collectibles.method: Choose "The tribes must stand together."

collectibles.name: Milo
collectibles.method: Choose "Beauty is deeper than our skin."

collectibles.name: Julian
collectibles.method: Choose "The present day matters too."

achievements.description: Win 30 consecutive Gold Class battles at the coliseum.
achievements.summary: Win 30 coliseum battles in a row at Gold Class.

guide.context: The 30 battles are back to back and fit in one day. Do it late in the game.

steps.text: Speak to the Spirited Receptionist and win ranked battles until you reach gold. You can fight 2 a day.
Speak to the Tactiturn Receptionist and pick the gold tier of the gauntlet.
Win 30 battles in a row.

achievements.description: Travel a significant distance by blade-riding.
achievements.summary: Travel a long distance by blade-riding.

guide.context: It takes about 40 minutes of riding in all. Do it in town without obstacles.

steps.text: Ride your sword with V whenever you travel in town.
Keep riding in open areas until it unlocks.

achievements.description: Help cook a meal at the inn with Maria.
achievements.summary: Help cook a meal with Maria at the inn.

steps.text: Raise Maria's bond a couple of times.
At the Hushed Honeybee Inn, find Maria by the counter and offer to help Fabienne with the cooking.
Choose the normal option. Maria then asks to help.

achievements.summary: Finish the three tower trials in the late-game questline.

steps.text: In the last months, take the new sidequests that send you to three towers.
Complete the dragon trials in the @loc{Tower of Insolence}, the @loc{Forsaken Tower} and the @loc{Spire of Blind Faith}.
Finish the questline.

achievements.description: Successfully challenge the test of courage at the highest difficulty.
achievements.summary: Pass the Spirited Youth's courage test on its hardest setting.

guide.context: Save first. It takes a few days. It is easier once Courage is high.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Martira}. Talk to the Spirited Youth by the cliff in Thoroughfare Square.
Take his test 3 times. The Courage rank you need goes up each time.
Pass the third test. If it fails, raise Courage and try again. Rank 4 or 5 is safe.

guide.context: Each ally adds one book. Julian's book is the seventh.

steps.text: Pick up each ally's book from the Gauntlet Runner bookshelf.
Get the seventh book from Julian at Angler's Inn Square in Port Brilehaven between 23 July and 13 August.
Read each book three times.
